summary: A clickable settings-style row that navigates somewhere, like box-item but acting as a link.
description: A link with a box-like shape that allows for custom title and description, rendering as an anchor with a trailing external-link nav icon.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label for the link. Inherited from MozBoxBase (toolkit/content/widgets/lit-utils.mjs).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Descriptive text for the link. Inherited from MozBoxBase.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon. Inherited from MozBoxBase.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: The href of the link. Ignored when supportPage is set (a support-link anchor is rendered instead).

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of a SUMO support page; when set, renders an is="moz-support-link" anchor instead of a plain href anchor (attribute support-page).

cssProperties.name: --box-button-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the link row (shared with box-button, both render class="button").

cssProperties.name: --box-button-text-color
cssProperties.description: Text color of the link row.
